text: Senate Resolution 9 - Introduced SENATE RESOLUTION NO. 9 BY WHITVER A Resolution deferring action on the confirmation of 1 certain appointments. 2 BE IT RESOLVED BY THE SENATE, That the Senate, under 3 the provisions of section 2.32, subsections 5 and 7, 4 defers the consideration of the confirmation of all 5 appointments that have been or are submitted by the 6 Governor or by an appointing authority other than the 7 Governor by, on, or after April 15, 2025, and that have 8 not yet been confirmed by the Senate by April 15, 2025. 9 -1- LSB 2988XS (1) 91 ss/ns 1/ 1
